STEP 1 - Scene: A airline-style economy meal tray (plated on paper/compostable plates) photographed from a fairly high frontal angle on a white tray table. It shows a main plate, a side plate and drinks.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The main plate is an oval/round disposable plate, roughly 24 cm across (the tray card and the cup give scale). Using a 24 cm diameter: area = 3.14 x 12^2 ≈ 452 cm^2. The smaller side plate (brownie) is roughly 18 cm, about 254 cm^2, but it is a separate plate so it is treated as its own vessel.

STEP 3 - Items (main plate): sliced roast beef/pot roast, roasted baby potatoes. (Side plate): pasta/noodle stir-fry with carrot and meat pieces. (Dessert plate): a brownie piece. Drinks (not weighed as food energy in the main estimate except juice): apple juice, water.

STEP 4 - Area (of main plate, 452 cm^2):
- Sliced beef: ~35% = 158 cm^2
- Baby potatoes: ~15% = 68 cm^2
Food covers ~50% of the main plate.

Side plate (254 cm^2, noodles fill most of it): noodles ~55% = 140 cm^2.
Dessert plate: brownie ~20% of its area, ~50 cm^2.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Beef: 158 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 237 ml
- Potatoes: 68 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 170 ml
- Noodle stir-fry: 140 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 350 ml
- Brownie: 50 cm^2 x 2 cm = 100 ml (dense piece, ~5 cm x 4 cm x 2.5 cm ≈ 50 ml actual; use ~50 ml)

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Beef: 237 x 0.9 ≈ 213 g
- Potatoes: 170 x 0.9 ≈ 153 g
- Noodles: 350 x 0.8 ≈ 280 g
- Brownie: 50 x 0.9 ≈ 45 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Beef (roast, lean-moderate): 213 g x 220 kcal/100g ≈ 469 kcal
- Potatoes (roasted): 153 g x 90 ≈ 138 kcal
- Noodle stir-fry (with oil): 280 g x 150 ≈ 420 kcal
- Brownie: 45 g x 420 ≈ 189 kcal
- Apple juice (~200 ml, about 90 kcal/100 ml) is not counted as a solid item but is noted; I am leaving it out of the item list.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 691 g and ≈ 1216 kcal. For a full airline tray with a main, side and dessert, this is plausible, though the main plate is only half covered, so the beef and potatoes may be slightly generous. Estimates are approximate.
